description: Establish a green baseline before implementing the battle animation. Confirm dependencies install, the full monorepo builds, and both test suites pass at their documented baselines (shared 47, frontend ui-helpers 17). This de-risks later verification by proving the toolchain works first.
steps: From repo root /projects/sandbox/kiro-digitalmonster run `npm install` to ensure workspace dependencies are present.
Run `npm run build` from the repo root and confirm all four workspaces (@ddm/shared, @ddm/backend, @ddm/frontend, infra) compile with no errors.
Run `npm test` from the repo root and confirm the shared suite passes (baseline 47 tests).
Run `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` and confirm the ui-helpers suite passes (baseline 17 tests).
Record the exact commands and their pass/fail results in this feature's findings field.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 with no TypeScript errors across all workspaces.
findings:
Baseline established and all green. Environment: Node v22.23.3, branch feat/battle-animation. Commands run from repo root /projects/sandbox/kiro-digitalmonster:
- `npm install` -> exit 0 (added 46 packages, 204 audited; 3 npm-audit advisories noted but unrelated, no action taken).
- `npm run build` -> exit 0. All four workspaces compiled with no TS errors: @ddm/shared (tsc), @ddm/backend (tsc), @ddm/frontend (tsc + vite build, 51 modules transformed, built in ~6.8s), infra (tsc).
- `npm test` (shared) -> exit 0, 47/47 pass (0 fail), matches baseline 47.
- `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` (ui-helpers / game-ui.test.ts) -> exit 0, 17/17 pass (0 fail), matches baseline 17.
No code changes made; animation implementation deferred to FEAT-002. Not committed per instructions.
